rp.pointsHint: Used for a very tough mission (12 to 20) or a custom award; the others give their own points.
rp.reasonHint: e.g. disarmed the bomb, defeated the Pirate Lord
rp.enemyHint: Defeating an enemy (killed, routed or forced to surrender) earns a Rank Point only if it was a real challenge: Tier {tier} (the party's) or higher (Core Rules p.326).
rp.lineUp: {name}: {before} → {after}, up to {rank}! Apply the rank from their Data Sheet.
rp.gmOnly: Only the GM awards Rank Points.
rp.noParty: No characters with a player owner.

menu.name: Optional Rules
menu.label: Optional Rules
menu.hint: Switch the books' optional rules on or off for this world, one by one.

rules.intro: Each optional rule can be switched on by itself. Everything is off by default, which plays the rules as written.

interruptLimit.name: One interrupting action per round
interruptLimit.hint: A player or NPC can only take a single Interrupting Action between their turns. In personal combat: one Counter-attack or free attack (point blank, or at someone running away). In space and vehicle combat: if someone Dogfights you (Tails a vehicle) after you've already rolled a Dogfight outside your turn, they win automatically.

playingDecimals.name: Playing the Decimals
playingDecimals.hint: Everyone gets this Karma Capability free (1 Karma): after a Skill check or Attack roll, roll another die and add the unit digit of the Skill score (3 for a Repair of 23). On 10 or more, +1 to the roll. A button appears on skill check and attack cards.

defenceTokens.name: Defence Tokens
defenceTokens.hint: Each time a ship or vehicle is attacked, it gains a Defence token once the attacker has fired all their weapons: +2 Defence per token against everyone else. They're discarded at the start of its turn.

groupFire.name: Group Fire
groupFire.hint: A ship or vehicle's identical weapons all fire together: one Attack roll, identical Damage from each. A critical hit only damages the component once. Use with caution with starting players.

avoidableExplosives.name: Avoidable Explosives
avoidableExplosives.hint: When a grenade or missile lands, everyone in its blast can react before it goes off: throw a grenade back (within 2m: a D10 of 8 or more), jump on it (within 4m: double its fatal Damage to you, its injury Damage to those in the fatal radius, nothing beyond), or run for cover (a Dodge check: that many metres, +2 per Quick Runner). Missiles and grenade launchers only allow running for cover.

interrupt.dogfightAuto: One interrupting action per round: {target} has already rolled a Dogfight this round, so {name} wins automatically.
interrupt.used: {name} has already taken an interrupting action since their last turn.

decimals.hint: 1 Karma: roll a D10 and add your Skill score's unit digit. On 10 or more, +1 to this roll (Core Rules p.263).
decimals.title: Playing the Decimals: {skill}
decimals.ok: Playing the Decimals: D10 {die} + {digit} = {sum}, +1 to the roll.
decimals.no: Playing the Decimals: D10 {die} + {digit} = {sum}, no change.

reaction.runHint: A Dodge check: you move that many metres (+2 per Quick Runner) before it goes off. A natural 1 and you don't get away.
reaction.throwHint: Within 2m of a grenade: roll a D10. On 8 or more you throw it back; otherwise it goes off at once.
reaction.jumpHint: Within 4m of a grenade: you take double its fatal Damage and are knocked over; those in the fatal radius take its injury Damage, and those beyond nothing.
reaction.jumpConfirm: Throw yourself on the grenade? You take double its fatal Damage to protect everyone else.
reaction.ranNot: {name} tries to run for cover but rolls a natural {die} and doesn't get away.
reaction.thrownLine: {name} throws it back (D10 {die}): it explodes where they throw it instead.
reaction.fumbledLine: {name} grabs for it (D10 {die}): it goes off at once.
reaction.jumpedNote: {name} is lying on it: the fatal radius takes the injury Damage, and the injury radius nothing.
reaction.thrownNote: Thrown back: it explodes where it was thrown, not where it first landed.
